The performance graph below shows the cumulative total stockholder return over a five-year period assuming the investment of 
$100 on December 31, 2012, in each of Juniper Networks' common stock, the Standard & Poor's 500 Stock Index (“S&P 500”), 
and the NASDAQ Telecommunications Index (“IXTC”). Total stockholder return assumes reinvestment of all dividends.
